name: PlantVillage MobileNetV3-Small Crop Classifier
license: MIT (declared by upstream model repository metadata)
inference_mode: local CPU ONNX inference; images are not sent to an AI API
provenance_note: Pinned to upstream revision d76fe187be1c4c3a5474f835a7a70cd08c7ab085. Upstream model card declares MIT; the repository does not include a standalone LICENSE file. Its metadata lists emmarex/plantdisease; underlying dataset terms have not been independently verified. Model artifacts are distributed with source attribution. Model labels cover only tomato, potato, and bell pepper.
training_dataset: PlantVillage; dataset provenance and training/evaluation claims are reported by the upstream model author and were not independently reproduced.
validation_status: ONNX tensor interface and a local inference pass verified in AgriBridge; upstream metrics are not independently reproduced.
production_prediction_status: Abstain-only until an exact-model calibration.json is backed by a held-out validation manifest; raw softmax values are not exposed as confidence.
limits_and_biases: Trained on curated PlantVillage images; field performance can be lower under varied lighting, backgrounds, occlusion, or multiple symptoms.
Not validated for crops or diseases outside the 15 published labels.
Predictions are assistive screening only and require confirmation by a qualified agricultural extension professional.
Management guidance in AgriBridge is illustrative and separately marked as demo guidance.
intended_use: Assistive crop-leaf screening, not a substitute for expert diagnosis.
